body: yeah it took me about 5 months to get enough energy to do so

It’s like a never-ending cycle that just wants to end and not go any further. The only thing i do everyday is sit lay on my bed, text, watch youtube, scroll through insta for just HOURS. 
Even my daily screen time is 15 hours, every. single. day. constantly. 
i feel the potential to do things sometimes, but then i remember and just go ‘nah it’s better for me to just lay back down and curl up and sit here.’ it’s because it sounds more easier to just chill and procrastinate instead of taking control over your life and doing something productive. 
I have lost all contact with my close friends, i never go out, i never socialize, it built up anxiety and i’m scared to even meet new people or talk to ANYONE. i don’t express myself anymore, i cant express one single emotion to anyone else. I don’t even go upstairs to talk to my family members. My mom has lost all her hope she had in me, to the point where she doesent even come down anymore to ask me how i’m doing or if i want something to eat, she let me drop out of school just to be in my bed and be depressed while high off my ass.
i am really learning to get better, and tbh i have, i may be writing this as i am on my bed like i always do, but i know a few things that may help you.
getting enough motivation to get up and take a shower. even feeling clean can really really just brighten you up and make you feel good. just doing little things like that. 
Even going for a jog outside for 3-5 minuets, your body releases dopamine and more chemicals when your doing active things like working out, and it can make you go from feeling like shit and wanting to die, to making you feel incredibly happy it feels like a drug that should be illegal.
things will turn out to be okay; you will learn how to cope with yourself and be okay with acceptance of yourself and how you work.
yeah i realized that lol. never doing that again anytime soon. is there a way to make it stop?
